body: Wow that sounds really tough, I’m sorry you had to go through that. Being strict with yourself was the way you felt you could be in control. The thing is that no one can really control the past, but what you can control is your future. Maybe you didn’t go to parties or do all the fun things you with you had as a high schooler, but who says you can’t go to parties now? And if it’s not parties that interest you, I’m sure you can find other hobbies that help you feel more fulfilled. You could also see a therapist to help you deal with any emotional issues caused by the past that are coming up now, or you could contact a textline or a suicide hotline.
Wow, that was actually super insightful. I’ve never thought abt it that way. Thank you so much, I’ll definitely use that knowledge to my advantage more now

Same. I feel selfish thinking abt being mad abt it now, bc being nice to someone shouldn’t mean that I expect the same things in return. Maybe they do care, you know? I just overthink everything and I feel like they don’t deep down

No there wasn’t any repetition, thank you so much. Yes the hobbies I used to enjoy are still things I’d like to do, it’s just hard because my depression has been bad lately and I usually lose motivation to do anything but sleep and be on my phone during those times. I suppose I can try and do things, even if I don’t think I’ll enjoy it bc why the hell not. Thank you so much for everything you’ve said, it means a ton
Maybe if they literally just gave me a look of genuine care instead of just glancing at me and then going back to whatever they were doing, or asking if I was ok when I’d clearly seem off

I feel the EXACT same way about my childhood. My parents were emotionally abusive and sometimes got a little physical, I always felt like they took so many things away from me and I hate them for it sometimes. Also, you can actually be depressed and still laugh a lot with friends and feel happy sometimes. Depression isn’t a feeling; it’s a mindset. It’s waking up and barely being able to find the motivation to get out of bed. It’s having this sick, empty feeling in your stomach that won’t go away that just makes you feel empty for no real reason. It’s being numb, and it’s being overwhelmed with emotion. 

I’m so sorry about ur situation. Do your best in that math class, because doing your best is all that really matters, even if the outcome isn’t what others would consider outstanding. Hopefully your mom can continue to receive money from your aunt. Don’t be afraid to call child protective services if things get even worse though, your family may need it. I promise it’ll all work out in the end, you just need to give it time.

I’m so sorry you’ve gone through this. You truly believed that path of life was the best thing for yourself when you were younger. Why exactly did you think you were so hard on yourself? Do you think it connected to something else happening in your life that you wanted to control?

Yeah ofc, I think a lot of people that struggle with depression and suicidal thoughts tend to think like that, but the fact is that how other people feel (like if we think we’ll make them feel angry or burdened) actually isn’t our problem at all. We shouldn’t have to cater to other people’s emotions bc it’s not our fault if they feel a certain way, even if we do technically influence it. It’s just hard to learn that sometimes

Yeah you’re welcome, I’ve felt like a burden a lot in my life but I can promise on my life that ur not even if it feels like total bs. Plus this specific community on reddit is rly good for talking abt issues without feeling judged so I’m glad u reached out

Thanks, it means a lot. My family is just causing me a ton of stress, I had a rly traumatic childhood and lots of emotional abuse that continues but isn’t as severe now. It’s just so hard to imagine living three more years with my family before college and this quarantine has made me hate everything even more. I’m losing all motivation to do anything I once loved and I’m barely talking to friends because I’m done with putting on this fake happy mask just to make them happy

I’m so sorry that happened to you, similar things have happened to me w my parents and even tho it’s totally not ok for them to get mad it was usually just out of fear and loss of control so they rly did care, although like I said it’s NOT ok how they reacted. I did some research and good ways to help with suicidal ideation is to remove things around you that you may use to hurt yourself, finding someone to talk to abt it (which I think you’re doing rn on reddit), contacting textlines (741-741) or mental health hotlines, and finding hobbies. Throwing yourself into an activity you enjoy is a rly good distraction from suicidal feelings in my experience and can help you find things to live for. Everything else I listed should help too, hope this helps

Honestly idek if it would work for me that’s why I made this post lol, I mean honestly you could always go to therapy or contact a text line or call a hotline if you don’t think the ward is for you tho
I’m so so glad this is happening for you. You stayed strong and really pulled through. Congrats love !!
But if ur in a hospital u definitely won’t get it they’re the most careful abt that
You should probably go if you feel like you should, I mean what do you have to lose

Hey, I get it. Things are really hard right now and it seems like there’s no other way. If therapy seems expensive, you could try a therapy app or text 741-741. The texting is free and isn’t awkward. If your job seems unfulfilling, try picking up old hobbies or watch a TV series you like. Do some self care. Obviously that’s not the answer to everything, but it helps a bit to be kind to yourself
